item.description:
### Added - **Keep Mac awake while agents are active.** A new opt-in in Settings → Sessions stops the Mac from dozing off mid-task: it holds off automatic system sleep while an agent is verifiably running, and through the approval window when one is waiting on you — so a permission can still be answered from your phone. It never fights the lid: closing it still sleeps the Mac. Off by default, and it releases the moment nothing is active.
### Changed - **Background alerts carry less.** The "needs you" push used to include the question or command text twice — once in the visible alert and again in a hidden field no phone ever read — plus an unread provider field. Both hidden copies are gone; the push now carries exactly what the notification shows plus the two fields the app uses (event kind and project). What each push class contains is spelled out, class by class, in SECURITY.md.
